module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  j,
    input  k,
    output reg Q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        case ({j, k})
            2'b00: Q <= Q;        // Hold state
            2'b01: Q <= 1'b0;     // Reset
            2'b10: Q <= 1'b1;     // Set
            2'b11: Q <= ~Q;       // Toggle
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input w,
    input R,
    input E,
    input L,
    output reg Q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (L) begin
            Q <= R;
        end else if (E) begin
            Q <= w;
        end
        // If neither L nor E is asserted, Q retains its previous value (no assignment)
    end

endmodule

Prob100_fsm3comb.code:
module TopModule (
    input in,
    input [1:0] state,
    output [1:0] next_state,
    output out
);
    // State encoding: A=2'b00, B=2'b01, C=2'b10, D=2'b11
    // Output logic: Moore machine, output depends only on current state
    assign out = (state == 2'b11); // D state -> output 1, else 0

    // Next state logic: combinational based on current state and input
    assign next_state = 
        (state == 2'b00) ? (in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00) : // A: in=0->A, in=1->B
        (state == 2'b01) ? (in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10) : // B: in=0->C, in=1->B
        (state == 2'b10) ? (in ? 2'b11 : 2'b00) : // C: in=0->A, in=1->D
        (state == 2'b11) ? (in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10) : // D: in=0->C, in=1->B
        2'b00; // Default (should not occur with valid 2-bit state)
endmodule

Prob115_shift18.code:
module TopModule (
    input  wire        clk,
    input  wire        load,
    input  wire        ena,
    input  wire [1:0]  amount,
    input  wire [63:0] data,
    output reg  [63:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            q <= data;
        end else if (ena) begin
            case (amount)
                2'b00: q <= {q[62:0], 1'b0};                    // left shift by 1
                2'b01: q <= {q[55:0], 8'b0};                    // left shift by 8
                2'b10: q <= {{1{q[63]}}, q[63:1]};              // arithmetic right shift by 1
                2'b11: q <= {{8{q[63]}}, q[63:8]};              // arithmetic right shift by 8
                default: q <= q;                                // should not happen
            endcase
        end
        // If neither load nor ena is active, q retains its value (no assignment needed)
    end

endmodule

Prob133_2014_q3fsm.code:
module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    input s,
    input w,
    output z
);
    // State encoding
    typedef enum logic [2:0] {
        A = 3'b000,  // Reset state: wait for s=1
        B0 = 3'b001, // In B, 0 w=1 seen so far, 0 cycles elapsed
        B1 = 3'b010, // In B, 0 w=1 seen so far, 1 cycle elapsed
        B2 = 3'b011, // In B, 0 w=1 seen so far, 2 cycles elapsed
        B3 = 3'b100, // In B, 1 w=1 seen so far, 0 cycles elapsed
        B4 = 3'b101, // In B, 1 w=1 seen so far, 1 cycle elapsed
        B5 = 3'b110, // In B, 1 w=1 seen so far, 2 cycles elapsed
        B6 = 3'b111  // In B, 2 w=1 seen so far, 0 cycles elapsed (terminal for checking)
    } state_t;

    state_t state, next_state;
    logic z_reg;

    // Output logic: z is 1 only in the state immediately after completing a 3-cycle window with exactly two w=1s
    assign z = (state == B6) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;

    // Next state logic
    always_comb begin
        next_state = state; // default hold
        unique case (state)
            A: begin
                if (s) begin
                    next_state = B0; // Enter B, start counting: 0 ones, 0 cycles
                end else begin
                    next_state = A; // Stay in A
                end
            end
            B0: begin // 0 ones, 0 cycles done
                if (w) begin
                    next_state = B3; // 1 one, 0 cycles done
                end else begin
                    next_state = B1; // 0 ones, 1 cycle done
                end
            end
            B1: begin // 0 ones, 1 cycle done
                if (w) begin
                    next_state = B4; // 1 one, 1 cycle done
                end else begin
                    next_state = B2; // 0 ones, 2 cycles done
                end
            end
            B2: begin // 0 ones, 2 cycles done
                if (w) begin
                    next_state = B5; // 1 one, 2 cycles done
                end else begin
                    next_state = B0; // 0 ones, 3 cycles done -> not exactly two, reset to B0 (start new window)
                end
            end
            B3: begin // 1 one, 0 cycles done
                if (w) begin
                    next_state = B6; // 2 ones, 0 cycles done
                end else begin
                    next_state = B4; // 1 one, 1 cycle done
                end
            end
            B4: begin // 1 one, 1 cycle done
                if (w) begin
                    next_state = B6; // 2 ones, 1 cycle done
                end else begin
                    next_state = B5; // 1 one, 2 cycles done
                end
            end
            B5: begin // 1 one, 2 cycles done
                if (w) begin
                    next_state = B6; // 2 ones, 2 cycles done
                end else begin
                    next_state = B0; // 1 one, 3 cycles done -> not exactly two, reset
                end
            end
            B6: begin // 2 ones, 0 cycles done (just completed a valid window)
                // After outputting z=1, we start a new window immediately
                if (w) begin
                    next_state = B3; // 1 one, 0 cycles done for new window
                end else begin
                    next_state = B1; // 0 ones, 0 cycles done for new window
                end
            end
        endcase
    end

    // State register
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= A;
        end else begin
            state <= next_state;
        end
    end

endmodule
